title: Inbox triage: spoofed payroll mail
description: Read a reported message the way an analyst would: headers, authentication results, reply-to, and the real destinations behind the links. Everything here is a fictional Northwind Lab sample — practice investigation skills, not memorization.
learningObjectives: Separate display name from the real From address
Interpret SPF / DKIM / DMARC as evidence, not as a single pass/fail verdict alone
Verify link destinations before trusting brand language
Treat Reply-To mismatches as an investigation lead
hints: Display names are free text. The address after @ is what you can test.
SPF fail plus a lookalike domain is stronger than urgency language alone.
Open the Engine tab to review extracted artifacts without guessing from the body only.

emailSamples.subject: Action required: payroll file rejected — confirm within 2 hours
emailSamples.preview: Your direct-deposit file was rejected. Confirm banking details immediately…
emailSamples.html:
Team,

The overnight payroll submission for Northwind Lab was rejected by the bank gateway.

You must confirm account details within 2 hours or Friday pay will be delayed.

Open payroll portal

Regards,
Payroll Operations
Northwind Lab
emailSamples.rawSource:
From: "Northwind Payroll" <noreply@northwind-payrol1.com>
Reply-To: helpdesk@northwind-payroll-support.xyz
Subject: Action required: payroll file rejected
Authentication-Results: spf=fail; dkim=none; dmarc=fail

TRAINING SAMPLE
emailSamples.headers:
From: "Northwind Payroll" <noreply@northwind-payrol1.com>
Reply-To: helpdesk@northwind-payroll-support.xyz
To: finance@northwind-lab.example
Subject: Action required: payroll file rejected — confirm within 2 hours
Date: Tue, 08 Sep 2026 08:12:04 +0000
Authentication-Results: mx.northwind-lab.example; spf=fail smtp.mailfrom=northwind-payrol1.com; dkim=none; dmarc=fail
